Yes, each letter in Arabic is assigned a specific value and you sum up the value for an entire sentence. There is a particular phrase in Islam that, when you apply this algorithm to, gives us 786. What is that phrase?
can think of 2.. not sure of the exact spelling but one is "bismillah rahmanur Rahim" "la ilaha illallaha Muhammadur rasulullah"
